st: Bring [[3 cups]] water and [[1 tsp]] salt to a boil in a heavy pot.
Mix [[1 cup]] of the cornmeal with [[1 cup]] cold water in a bowl to a smooth paste, then stir it into the boiling water.
Cover and cook on low for 5 minutes, until it thickens like a loose porridge.
Add the remaining [[1 cup]] cornmeal in a thin stream, without stirring, so it forms a mound in the middle. Cover and steam for 10 minutes.
Stir hard with a wooden spoon, breaking up lumps, until the papa is stiff and smooth. Cover and cook 10 minutes more on very low heat.
Meanwhile heat [[1 tbsp]] oil in a skillet, cook the onion 4 minutes, then add the tomatoes and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and pepper and cook for 4 minutes until wilted.
Scoop the papa into mounds and serve with the spinach and tomato relish.
Wash the spinach well and chop it roughly. Shred the cabbage.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft and golden at the edges.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cabbage with [[0.5 cup]] water and [[0.75 tsp]] salt. Cover and cook for 10 minutes until it starts to soften.
Add the spinach in handfuls, stir and cover for 8 minutes until everything is tender.
Season with the pepper, taste for salt and serve hot with papa.

ing: dried, cracked corn kernels, soaked overnight
st: The night before, cover the samp and beans with plenty of cold water and soak overnight. Drain and rinse both.
Put the samp, beans and [[8 cups]] water in a large pot and bring to a boil. Skim off any foam.
Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours, adding hot water if it gets dry, until the beans are completely tender and the samp is soft.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a skillet and cook the onion for 5 minutes until golden.
Add the tomatoes and cook for 6 minutes until they break down into a sauce.
Stir the tomato mixture into the pot with [[1.5 tsp]] salt and the pepper.
Simmer uncovered 15 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick. Taste for salt before serving.
Stir [[1 cup]] sorghum meal and [[0.25 cup]] cornmeal with [[2 cups]] lukewarm water in a glass or ceramic bowl until smooth. Stir in [[2 tbsp]] yogurt if you want a faster start.
Cover loosely with a cloth and leave in a warm place for 24 to 48 hours until it smells pleasantly sour and bubbles slightly.
Bring [[3 cups]] water to a boil in a heavy pot.
Whisk the fermented mixture into the boiling water, then keep whisking for 2 minutes so it does not lump.
Mix the remaining [[0.25 cup]] cornmeal with a little cold water and stir it in to thicken.
Cook on low for 20 minutes, stirring often, until the porridge is thick and smooth.
Stir in [[0.25 cup]] sugar, serve warm or cold with a splash of milk.
Heat [[2 tbsp]] oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger and chili and stir for 1 minute.
Stir in [[2 tbsp]] curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the bell peppers and carrots and cook for 8 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add the tomatoes and [[1 tsp]] salt and simmer for 10 minutes until saucy.
Stir in the baked beans with their sauce and cook for 5 more minutes.
Taste, adjust salt and heat, and serve warm or cold with papa, bread or grilled meat.
